name: hipaa
description: Protected Health Information (PHI) handling, encryption, and access control guardrails for Hermes agent workflows.

rules.message: Potential Social Security Number (SSN) detected in output.
rules.suggestion: Redact SSNs before logging, storing, or transmitting.
remediation_steps: Route PHI through approved encryption layer

rules.suggestion: Treat medical record numbers as PHI and redact.
Obscure health plan identifiers under HIPAA safe harbor.

rules.message: Credential secret exposed in visible text.
rules.suggestion: Load secrets from secret manager only; never print.
remediation_steps: Replace hard-coded secret with env var or vault ref

rules.message: PHI sharing without Business Associate Agreement (BAA) confirmation.
rules.suggestion: Require signed BAA before transmitting PHI to any vendor.
remediation_steps: Pause transmission until BAA is on file
Log audit event for compliance review
